reference.title: AuditX Troubleshooting Guide
reference.shortdesc: Solutions to common issues and problems you might encounter while using AuditX. Organized by problem category with step-by-step resolution instructions.

ol.li: Verify you are using the correct email address associated with your account
Check that Caps Lock is not enabled
Click "Forgot Password" to reset your credentials
Wait 10 minutes and retry with new password
If still failing, contact AuditX support

dlentry.dt: Problem: Account locked after multiple failed attempts

ol.li: Wait 30 minutes for account to unlock automatically
Or click "Forgot Password" to unlock via email link
Reset your password through the email verification process
Verify your user role has permission for this feature (check User Roles reference)
Confirm you are logged in as the correct user
Ask an Admin to verify your user permissions
Try logging out and logging back in

dlentry.dt: Problem: Email is missing or delayed

ol.li: Check your spam or junk folder - automated emails are often filtered
Wait 5-10 minutes for email to arrive (system takes time to send)
Check that email is spelled correctly in the password reset form
Request a new password reset email if link expires (valid for 24 hours)
Contact AuditX support if email still doesn't arrive

dlentry.dt: Problem: Device shows no lights or response

ol.li: Verify power cable is firmly connected to device and power outlet
Try a different power outlet to rule out outlet failure
Check that power strip (if used) is turned on
Wait 30 seconds for device to boot up after power connection
If device still unresponsive, contact AuditX support (may indicate hardware failure)

section.title: Camera Not Capturing Video or Images

dlentry.dt: Problem: Recording starts but no video is saved

ol.li: Verify camera lens is clean and not obstructed
Check that device has available storage space (check credit balance)
Verify workflow is properly assigned to the device via Config Group
Restart the AuditX device
Test with a simple manual recording to isolate workflow issue
If still failing, contact AuditX support

dlentry.dt: Problem: Video quality is poor or pixelated

ol.li: Clean camera lens with soft, dry cloth
Check lighting at packing station - ensure adequate brightness
Verify resolution is set to appropriate level (4K vs 1080p)
Check network connection stability if using cloud storage
Reduce activity in nearby WiFi channels if wireless connection

dlentry.dt: Problem: Barcodes scanned but not recognized by AuditX

ol.li: Verify barcode scanner is powered on and connected
Test scanner on a known working barcode (e.g., product packaging)

Check barcode length range configuration in workflow:
Your barcodes may not match Min/Max length settings
Expand length range if needed
Enable "Suppress Control Characters" if scanner adds extra codes
Verify barcode field name matches your barcode type
Try disabling barcode classification rules to test basic scanning

dlentry.dt: Problem: Scanning takes too long or causes delays

ol.li: Check that barcode classification RegEx patterns are not overly complex
Verify scanner is reading barcodes cleanly (no partial reads)
Check device processor load (restart if running many tasks)
Ensure WiFi/network connection is stable if using cloud sync

dlentry.dt: Problem: Created workflow but device not recording

ol.li: Verify workflow is part of a Config Group (see "Create Config Groups")
Confirm Config Group is assigned to your system (see "Assign Config Group to System")
Check that system status is "Active" (green indicator)
Reload/restart the device to load new configuration
Check in Reports to verify events are being recorded

dlentry.dt: Problem: Orders not appearing in Order Verification workflow

ol.li: Verify Event URL Report is enabled in Settings (required for Shopify)
Check Shopify store name is correct (e.g., "mystore" from mystore.myshopify.com)
Verify Shopify API access key is valid (check in Shopify Admin)
Allow 5-10 minutes for first sync of orders
Test with a recent order placed in Shopify
Check AuditX system date/time - must match Shopify server time
If still failing, regenerate API key in Shopify Admin

dlentry.dt: Problem: Created events but cannot find them in Reports

ol.li:
Verify filter settings are not excluding your events:
Check Site filter is set to correct location
Verify date range includes when event was recorded
If searching by barcode/event ID, verify exact value
Check device system time is correct (incorrect time can cause filtering issues)
Allow 1-2 minutes for events to appear in reports (slight processing delay)
Verify workflow is active and Config Group assigned to device
Check system credit balance - no credits = no new recordings

dlentry.dt: Problem: Download button not working or CSV file is empty

ol.li: Verify report has data (check that filters are not too restrictive)
Try again - temporary network issues may cause download to fail
Clear browser cache and try again
Try different browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
Check that browser allows downloads from AuditX domain
For very large exports, try exporting smaller date ranges

dlentry.dt: Problem: Video won't play or playback is choppy

ol.li: Verify internet connection speed is adequate (minimum 5 Mbps for HD video)
Try closing other applications using bandwidth
Clear browser cache and temporary files
Try a different browser or device
Wait 30 seconds for video to buffer before playing
Lower playback quality setting if available
Try downloading the video file and playing locally instead of streaming

dlentry.dt: Problem: "Credit Exhausted" message appears, recording stopped

ol.li: Check your current credit balance in account settings
Purchase additional credits through your AuditX account
Alternatively, delete old or unnecessary events to free space
Check Credit Exhaust configuration - if set to "Overwrite", oldest events will be replaced
Note: Some events may not be recovered after overwrite, plan accordingly

section.title: Contact Support
section.p: If you cannot resolve an issue using this troubleshooting guide:

ol.li: Gather information: screenshot, error message, steps to reproduce
Note your system serial number and product name

Send an email to AuditX support including:
Description of the issue
Product name and serial number
Steps you have already tried
Screenshot or error message if available
List of connected peripherals (scanner, camera, etc.)
AuditX support will respond within 24 hours with assistance
